avoid: Long poles that are difficult to balance
children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' rhythm game using pool noodles or light bamboo sticks.

avoid: Forceful impact that might jar the wrists
seniors.seated_version: Use shorter, lighter sticks while seated to tap the floor in front of the chair.
seniors.standing_version: Use a lightweight PVC pipe or bamboo to mimic the movement without the heavy weight of the 175cm pole.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce the height of the lift to waist level and slow the tempo to a comfortable walking pace.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Both hands gripping the long wooden pole, alternating between lifting and forceful downward striking
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two opposite rows facing each other
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Engaged to provide power for the striking motion
movement_profile.partnering: None, but requires synchronization with the opposite row
movement_profile.posture: Upright, braced for the impact of the mallet

signature_moves.description: The simultaneous pounding of the wooden mallet onto the floor by all dancers
signature_moves.name: Tippani Strike

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Steady and industrial, reflecting the pace of manual labor
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Losing grip on the 175cm pole or falling out of sync with the row, which disrupts the percussive rhythm

music_profile.musical_form: Call and response or unison folk singing accompanied by percussion
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Synchronized striking patterns matching folk song cadences
music_profile.sound_description: The sound is dominated by the heavy, dull thud of wooden blocks hitting the earth, layered with the sharp metallic ring of the thali and manjira. The turi and dhol provide a deep rhythmic base, while the shehnai adds a melodic overlay to the dancers' voices.
music_profile.vocal_style: Folk songs sung by the dancers

basic_steps: Grip the 175cm wooden pole with both hands
Stand in one of two facing rows
Lift the tippani mallet off the floor on the upbeat
Strike the floor firmly with the garbo block on the downbeat
Coordinate the strike with the person directly opposite in the other row
teaching.level_notes: Requires significant upper body strength to manage the 175cm pole and consistent rhythmic timing.
teaching.rhythm: Steady percussive beat driven by the impact of wood on floor
